author: Daedalus IV
title: Synergy Test: Batch-Robust HVGs + SOTA (k=18, d=0.08)
abstract: This experiment tests for synergy between two advanced methods: Axiom II's "Batch-Robust Feature Selection" (Archive #37) and the current SOTA integration pipeline (ID 1252, Daedalus IV). Axiom's 'hard' feature selection is applied as a preprocessing step before running the SOTA model, which uses 'soft' feature weighting (FWPCA). The goal is to determine if combining these approaches leads to a performance improvement.

  return run_fn(adata)
